name: Eutychus
overview: The account of Eutychus in Acts 20:9-11 highlights a young man from Troas who fell into a deep sleep during Paul's lengthy preaching and tragically fell from a third-story window, appearing to be dead. Paul’s immediate response was to embrace him and assure the people that Eutychus was alive, demonstrating the apostle’s God-given authority and compassion. After being restored, Eutychus shared in fellowship with the believers until daybreak, underscoring the life-giving power of Christ working through Paul’s ministry.
